about_the_game:
■Story■

Shau is a traveling swordsman. He travels the galaxy's fringes in search of legendary ancient weapons to save his homeland.

He arrives in a city on a colonized planet where he meets two women.

Akiko is the daughter of a powerful noble family that rules the planet.

She is known not only for her natural swordsmanship, but also for her incredible combat prowess, having created numerous high-performance androids modeled after her own appearance.

Shau is drawn to her refined swordsmanship and her somewhat cold beauty.

Akiko is interested in Shau, but the chains of family and duty are deeply ingrained in her heart.

A mysterious hacker known as the "Megitsune(Shuri)" lives in the underground of the Cyber City.

She always hides her true face behind a cyber fox mask.

Few know her true identity, but her exceptional cyber skills and occasional glimpses of ancient swordsmanship suggest she is no ordinary person.

Shuri resonates with Shau's loneliness and strength, and secretly supports him.

One night, Akiko and Shuri meet on the backstreets at the cyberpunk city.

Akiko is accompanied by countless androids of her own, as if to show off her power and technology.

She is heading towards Shuri, intending to test her strength.

Meanwhile, Shuri stands silently where she is.

The expression behind the fox mask is unknown, but a sharp fighting spirit radiates from her entire body.

Akiko quietly raises her hand, and the countless androids move all at once. Each one readies their light blade, exactly like Akiko's, and attacks Shuri.

Behind her fox mask, Shuri's eyes shine sharply. She draws the light blade tucked at her waist and slashes at the approaching horde of androids with lightning speed.

One against many. The battle with androids, the pinnacle of cutting-edge technology, and a mysterious fox-masked hacker begins.

- Main Characters -

Shuri (Megitsune): The protagonist of the story. Nicknamed "Megitsune" because she always wears a fox mask, she lives underground as a mysterious hacker. She possesses exceptional ancient swordsmanship.

Akiko: The daughter of a powerful noble family that rules the planet. Not only is she an excellent swordsman, but she has also created numerous high-performance androids modeled after her, giving her overwhelming strength in combat.

Shau: A traveling swordsman. In order to save her homeland, he travels the galaxy in search of legendary ancient weapons.

■Note■

The trial version allows you to play the first stage.

■Content■

The game is an action-adventure game in which you defeat enemies along the story.

There are 5 stages, 1 to 5 in total, and each time you clear the stage you will learn the secret of a new attack technique that you can use from the next stage (see *2～5 in ■How to operate■).

There are "Ancient symbols" for fully "Restoring stamina" and "Slow motion power" in several places along the way on the stages.

Also, other "Ancient symbols" for opening the "Wall gate" come in sets of two (Parent and the child, should be the same Ancient symbols). Go near and Press "F-key" or "RB" (Operate) in the order of the Child ancient symbol then Parent ancient symbol (on the Wall gate), and the gate will open.

■How to operate■

You can control Megitsune with keyboard & mouse, or gamepad ("Attack(Big)" or "Stealth" requires keyboard control).

Available marked with "*" can be used from the stage with that number. 

・Jump: (Spacebar) or (Y) button on the gamepad

・Move: (W S A D), ↑↓←→, or (L thumbstick) on the gamepad

・Look Around: (Up/Down/Left/Right) on the mouse or (R thumbstick) on the gamepad

・Defend: (E) key on the keyboard or (A) button on the gamepad

・Attack(Small): (Left mouse button) or (X) button on the gamepad

・Attack(Big)*5: (Right mouse button) or Right Shift key

・Attack (Spinning)*4: (Middle mouse button) or Left Trigger (LT) on the gamepad

・Attack (Both Hands)*2: (Left Ctrl) key or (B) button on the gamepad

・Attack (Thrust)*3: (Left Alt) key or Right Trigger (RT) on the gamepad

・Stealth Thrust: (R) key on the keyboard

・Stealth Mode: (C) key on the keyboard

・Slow Motion: (Enter) key or (R Thumbstick Down) on the gamepad

・Run: Move key + (Left Shift) or Left Bumper (LB) on the gamepad

・Operate: (F) on the keyboard or Right Bumper (RB) on the gamepad

■Operating environment■

It has been confirmed to work in an environment with 9th generation Core i5, 32GB RAM, RTX4070TiSuper, and Windows 10.

Planning and production Kink Bunko

BGM:

(Trailer) Snow,blizzarding written by Sachiko Kamaboko

(Stage 1) Goddess written by Make a field Music

(Stage 2) 孤独な少女 written by ゆうり(from Yuli Audio Craft)

(Stage 3) Under line written by Make a field Music

(Stage 4) The secret of siliver steel colors city written by Sachiko Kamaboko

(Stage 5) 乱桜舞弾幕 written by 伊藤ケイスケ

(Ending A) 思い返すと written by マニーラ

(Ending B) In the back alley of ancient capital written by Sachiko Kamaboko

Please note that we are not responsible for any damage caused by using this app.

All Kink Bunko works are born from fantasy. No depictions are intended to encourage acts that would be illegal in real life. Please enjoy them solely as made-up stories.

content_descriptors.notes:
In this action game, all female characters (Shuri, Akiko, and Nako), a male character (Shau), are topless. Women's breasts jiggle. Characters are slashed to death with swords, but no blood is shown.
The ending video uses an images of sword killing scene, but no blood is shown.
